original_test_intent: Unresolved as sourced: the named Boot Status semantic belongs to SMBIOS Type 32 System Boot Information, while Items, script and command explicitly identify Type 17 Memory Device. Executing either scope without correction would rewrite source intent.
original_method: Do not execute the Type 17 grep or silently substitute Type 32. Preserve the mismatch and, after the owner corrects the canonical structure, exact status/additional-data semantics, stimulus and expected lifecycle, create a structure-specific review and approved reboot plan.
manual_activity: An engineer/vendor must correct the testcase identity and expected status semantics. This is not manual-only execution.
required_inputs: Canonical SMBIOS structure and corrected item/script
Exact Boot Status offset/length and SMBIOS revision
Expected status code and any additional-data interpretation
Whether the test observes normal boot only or a defined failure stimulus
Approved reboot/recovery and evidence lifecycle after correction
safety_requirements: Do not treat absence from Type 17 as PASS or substitute Type 32 without owner correction.
Do not clear logs, restore defaults or change memory/BIOS settings while scope is unresolved.
Do not create a boot failure or reboot merely to populate status without an approved stimulus/recovery plan.
Read-only Type 17/32 raw collection may be retained only as mismatch clarification evidence.
Re-review after correction; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Preserve source conflict and optionally collect read-only schema evidence in a later authorized execution task.
Do not select the structure, induce boot failures, run the invalid grep or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Correct the target to Type 32 Boot Status or supply a different real Type 17 field and rename the case.
Define status/additional-data criteria and stimulus/recovery, approve execution and issue the formal verdict after re-review.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not fit: a conforming Type 17 Memory Device record has no Boot Status field, so the command returns absence or unrelated text and cannot test the named semantic.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: BLOCKED pending source correction. After correction, use exact raw Type 32 field parsing or the newly identified Type 17 target; never infer PASS from an empty grep.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source Type 17 item, script and 5/5-minute values are retained as conflict evidence and do not authorize Type 32 substitution or reboot.

modernized_recommendation.status: NO EXECUTION METHOD UNTIL STRUCTURE IS CORRECTED
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: If corrected to Type 32, parse raw Boot Status and additional data by version/length, define the approved boot stimulus/lifecycle and compare only evidence relevant to that status.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Cannot be fixed until the canonical structure and stimulus are chosen.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Owner must specify the applicable SMBIOS revision.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable owner-selected SMBIOS structure definition after correction.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Would replace a nonexistent Type 17 text match with exact structure-specific raw validation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Would prevent false PASS on absence and separate normal-boot observation from deliberately induced failure status.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Corrected structure, status criteria, stimulus and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Boot Status can represent a dynamic boot outcome; persistence/equality across reboot may be inappropriate unless the expected lifecycle is defined.

project_override_considerations: A project may correct this case to Type 32 through an approved override while preserving Master Source history, but must version the status/stimulus/recovery criteria and not silently alter the shared library.
expected_evidence: Owner/vendor correction naming canonical structure, field offset/length and version
Defined status/additional-data criteria plus normal/failure stimulus and recovery
After correction only: raw structure and approved boot/health evidence

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Boot Status is a Type 32 System Boot Information field, not a Type 17 Memory Device field. Items/script/command conflict with the named semantic, and an empty Type 17 grep is not acceptance evidence.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Correct target, status semantics and stimulus/recovery cannot be determined without rewriting the source; this is irreducible until owner correction.
